title: Provision tenant
description: Set up a new tenant for your organization.
fieldRejected: This value was rejected. Adjust it and try again.

toast.readyInvited: {name} is ready. {invitee} has been invited as tenant administrator.
toast.failedDescription: The request did not complete. Review the details below and try again.

discard.title: Discard this tenant?
discard.description: Nothing has been provisioned yet. Leaving now discards what you have entered.

failure.permission: Your Platform administration access has changed. Sign in again to provision a tenant.
failure.validation: The request was rejected before anything was created. Your entries are kept.
failure.conflict: This request conflicts with one already recorded.
failure.unavailable: Provisioning did not complete and the outcome is unknown. Submit again without changing anything — the retry is safe and will not create a second tenant. If it keeps failing, check the tenant list before entering different details.
failure.unexpected: Provisioning did not complete and the outcome is unknown. Submit again without changing anything — the retry is safe and will not create a second tenant.

serverErrors.name_invalid: Tenant name must be 2 to 100 characters.

tenant-hr-admin.label: Tenant HR Administrator
tenant-hr-admin.hint: This role has full administrative access within the tenant.
tenant-hr-admin.summary: Full administrative access to manage settings, users, products and more within the tenant.

hr-manager.label: HR Manager
hr-manager.hint: Manages people and HR records, without tenant configuration.
hr-manager.summary: Manages employees, organization structure and HR records, without access to tenant-wide settings.

read-only.label: Read-only Auditor
read-only.hint: Can view records across the tenant but cannot make changes.
read-only.summary: Read-only visibility across the tenant for review and audit, with no ability to make changes.

organization.description: Provide the basic information for the new tenant workspace.

organization.shortDescriptionPlaceholder: e.g. Global headquarters workspace for Acme Corporation.

about.title: About tenant setup

naming.title: Naming guidance
naming.unique: The tenant slug must be unique.

naming.later: You can always update these details later.

region.title: Region and default settings
region.description: These settings define the tenant's defaults.

products.title: Product entitlements
products.description: Select the Fusion products to enable for this tenant.
products.aboutBody: Core HR is included with every tenant. Products marked unavailable aren’t offered in this build yet.
